# Gateway configuration

Every key of the gateway TOML file read by `bhms gateway <file>` (and `python -m bhms.gateway <file>`), with its default, taken from `bhms.gateway.config`. Unknown keys are refused at start-up with the key named. Worked examples: [`examples/bhms/gateway.toml`](../../../examples/bhms/gateway.toml) and [`examples/bhms/compact-gateway.toml`](../../../examples/bhms/compact-gateway.toml); guide: [Deploying a gateway](../guides/gateway.md).

## `[gateway]`

| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `"gateway"` | Identity in the derived upstream idempotency keys (BHMS-AUTH-014); `[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,32}`. |
| `state_dir` | `"state"` | Forwarding journal and fences. Relative paths are relative to the TOML file. |
| `durability` | `"dispatch"` | `dispatch` (fsync before forwarding), `full` or `process`. |
| `listen` | `[]` | Any of `unix:<path>` (relative to the TOML file), `ws://127.0.0.1:<port>`, `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<http_path>`, `stdio`. The file has no TLS options: `wss://`/`https://` and non-loopback addresses need `Gateway.listen(url, ssl=...)` (embedding) or a TLS-terminating proxy in front of a loopback listener. |
| `trust_same_uid` | `true` | Unix-socket peers with the gateway's uid that no principal names get `admin`. Set `false` and list `uids` for explicit control. |
| `instructions` |  | Guidance served to clients and models (untrusted text). |
| `key_retention_s` | `604800` | At least 86400 (BHMS-OPS-034). |
| `event_retention_s` | `604800` |  |
| `max_wait_ms` | `60000` |  |
| `max_page_size` | `500` |  |
| `lease_min_ttl_ms` | `1000` |  |
| `lease_max_ttl_ms` | `600000` |  |
| `lease_max_wait_ms` | `30000` |  |
| `stop_deadline_ms` | `3000` | Added to a stop's `waitMs`: how long the gateway waits for each upstream's answer before reporting a device `initiated`. |
| `connect_wait_ms` | `10000` | How long start-up waits for upstreams to connect before serving. |
| `upstream_timeout_ms` | `10000` | Default bound of every call to an upstream (BHMS-SEC-061). |
| `observation_min_interval_ms` | `50` |  |
| `http_path` | `"/bhms"` | Path of the Streamable HTTP listener. |

## `[[upstream]]`

| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | Namespace: device `stage-z` is served as `<name>/stage-z`. `[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,32}`, no `/`. |
| `stdio` |  | Command line spawned (and restarted) by the gateway; `{python}` and `{config_dir}` are expanded. |
| `url` |  | A running server: `unix:<path>`, `ws://host:port`; give exactly one of `stdio`, `url` (or `type = "compact"`). |
| `timeout_ms` | `10000` | Bound of every call; defaults to `[gateway] upstream_timeout_ms`. |
| `queue_size` | `64` | Calls waiting behind `max_inflight` before the gateway answers `BUSY`. |
| `max_inflight` | `32` |  |
| `health_interval_ms` | `2000` | Liveness probe period. |
| `health_timeout_ms` | `2000` | A probe not answered in time marks the upstream's devices unavailable. |
| `env` | `{}` | Environment of a `stdio` upstream (values expand `{config_dir}` and `{python}`). |
| `cwd` |  | Working directory of a `stdio` upstream (default: the TOML file's directory). |
| `token_env` |  | Name of an environment variable holding the upstream's bearer token. |
| `token_file` |  | File holding the upstream's bearer token (relative to the TOML file). |

### Compact upstreams (`type = "compact"`)

A microcontroller speaking BHMS-Compact over a serial line, served by a bridge inside the gateway ([guide](../guides/arduino.md)). Keys besides `name` and the common timing keys above:

| Key | Notes |
|---|---|
| `baud` | Serial speed (default 115200, 8N1, raw). |
| `hello_timeout_ms` | Wait for one HELLO (default 1000). |
| `poll_interval_ms` | QUERY period of a running operation (default 2000). |
| `port` | `/dev/ttyACM0` (USB CDC or UART), `pty:/dev/pts/N` or `unix:<path>`; networked links are refused (BHMS-SEC-050). |
| `probe_interval_ms` | Liveness probe period of an idle link (default 2000). |
| `probe_misses` |  |
| `reply_timeout_ms` | Wait for one reply before retransmitting or querying (default 1000). |
| `retries` | Further tries before an operation is recorded `unknown` (default 3). |
| `sidecar` | The device's full DeviceDescription with `compact` layouts (relative to the TOML file); its digest must match the board's HELLO. |
| `stop_confirm_ms` |  |
| `type` | `"compact"`. |

## `[principals.<name>]`

A `GatewayPolicy` principal (spec [13.2](../../../spec/bhms/13-security.md)):

| Key | Notes |
|---|---|
| `tokens` | Bearer tokens as `sha256:<hex>` digests, never plaintext: `python -c "from bhms import token_digest; print(token_digest('my-token'))"`. |
| `uids` | Unix-socket peers (uids) that are this principal. |
| `scopes` | `read`, `lease`, `invoke:<deviceGlob>/<actionGlob>` (split at the last `/`), `invoke:cap:<capabilityGlob>`, `stop`, `stop:<deviceGlob>`, `programs:run`, `programs:register`, `operations:read`, `operations:resolve`, `admin`. |
| `bounds` | `{"<deviceId>/<action>" = {<argument> = {minimum?, maximum?, enum?}}}`: narrowing only. |

Check what each scope matches with `bhms gateway check-policy <file>`. SIGHUP re-reads `[principals]`.
